title: Codex-to-Claude Worker Result
description: Normalized worker result handed back to the Codex aggregator. Produced by the wrapper from Claude's final result event plus locally observed signals (diff, verification exit codes). Direct port of worker-contracts.md draft at lines 96-155, with annotations added.

task_id.description: Must match the dispatched task spec's task_id. The aggregator rejects any result whose task_id does not correspond to a dispatched task.

session_id.description: Claude session UUID. Captured from the system/init event so the conversation can be resumed via --resume or --session-id.

status.description: Wrapper-determined outcome. "succeeded" requires claude_meta.subtype == "success" AND every entry in changed_files lies inside the task's allowed_paths AND every verification_commands entry exited 0.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence description of what the worker actually did.

changed_files.description: Files modified during the run (paths relative to the workspace). Reconciled against the actual git diff by the wrapper before the result is emitted.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. Zero is success unless the command itself documents otherwise.

summary.description: Optional one-line interpretation of the command output.

commands_run.description: Every verification_commands entry actually executed, with its exit code. Commands skipped (with reason) belong in notes_for_codex.

risks.description: Outstanding risks the worker identified that are not resolved by this task. Empty array if none.

needs_human_review.description: Set when the worker is uncertain or when the diff exceeds what was clearly authorized. Overrides status == "succeeded" for downstream gating.

notes_for_codex.description: Free-form notes to the aggregator: constraints a follow-up worker must respect, skipped verification commands and why, observed environment quirks. Must not contain secrets.

claude_meta.description: Selected fields lifted from Claude's final result event so the aggregator can distinguish failure modes without re-reading the raw event log.

subtype.description: Claude result.subtype. "error_max_structured_output_retries" specifically signals --json-schema could not be satisfied; do not blind-retry on this value.

terminal_reason.description: Claude result.terminal_reason. Distinguishes, e.g., a max_turns timeout from a hook_stopped abort.

total_cost_usd.description: Cost reported by Claude for this single worker invocation.

permission_denials.description: Claude SDKPermissionDenial entries. Field-level shape is only formalized in SDK typings; treat opaquely. Non-empty under dontAsk warrants status == "blocked", not auto-escalation.
